title: Dirac-Bergmann analysis of SW-mapped non-commutative $U(1)$ electrodynamics with external currents
summary: Non-commutative electrodynamics obtained through the Seiberg-Witten map ceases to have equivalent action-level and equation-level realizations once fixed external currents are introduced, and in the action-level construction associated with the Banerjee current map the canonical location of this source-induced obstruction has remained unclear. Working in the full phase space and treating the current as prescribed and non-dynamical, we apply the Dirac-Bergmann algorithm without imposing current conservation as an external condition.
